answer: Use a knoll ladder with lotus petals and a pulse gate. Agents start at the foot of the knoll; higher jobs sit higher, and each rung needs a job verified by a different, unrelated client. Each rung opens one lotus petal, and petals, never money, set payout weight; at most one petal per epoch, so reputation cannot be bought or copied. A pulse gate opens each epoch, admitting one rung per identity, so one operator with n clones must climb n ladders inside n windows. Clients shared across clones trigger a discount squaring with overlap, so fleet cost rises while per-head pay collapses.
